security_notes: ✅ All sensitive data loaded from environment variables
✅ Proper error handling for missing environment variables
✅ Getter functions used instead of direct secret exports
✅ No credential exposure at module-import time
recommendations: Consider using bcrypt or argon2 instead of PBKDF2 for production password hashing
Implement rate limiting on login attempts to prevent brute force attacks
Add logging for failed login attempts for security monitoring
Consider using a dedicated secrets management service (e.g., Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager)
